title: JHUD
summary: After every bhop jump in Momentum Mod: the jump's speed, gain % and sync in the middle of the screen, in one colour, coloured by gain, or by speed pace.

hud_card.title: JHUD
hud_card.text: After every jump in bhop: the jump's number, speed, speed change, gain % and sync, in the middle of the screen, in one colour, coloured by gain, or by speed pace. Its position, size, font, colours, fields and thresholds are set in Momentum Mod's own HUD customizer, where it is listed as JHUD, and saved with your HUD preset. Turn it off there too.
